sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Seli

lines.text: That channel is clear because I clear it. This one has reeds because I leave them.
A moving leaf tells me more about the water than an empty channel does.
Watch a leaf where the cleared channel meets the reeds. Keeping water moving does not mean clearing everything away.
You followed the shadow, not the animal. That is a useful way of watching water as well as air.
